title: Token-Weighted Multi-Target Learning for Generative Recommenders with Curriculum Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Conducting a head-tail analysis by ranking items by interaction frequency, splitting them into head (top 50% most frequent) and tail (bottom 50% least frequent) groups, and evaluating recommendation performance (e.g., Hit@k, NDCG@k) separately on these subsets to assess whether the model disproportionately favors frequent items.
